_comment: SIH_AVIAN_FINAL Phase 2 -- coarse label mapping for the primary detector. 192 defects across 28 distinct types (checked against the real rendered dataset, not the master prompt's own '19 types' estimate -- METRO alone contributes 8 types (PIER_SPALL, PIER_CORROSION_STAIN, INTERNAL_SOFFIT_CRACK, WEB_SHEAR_CRACK, SOFFIT_TRANSVERSE_CRACK, SEGMENTAL_JOINT_LEAKAGE, BEARING_DISTRESS, EFFLORESCENCE_JOINT) beyond the road+steel taxonomy that estimate was based on) is roughly 7 unique-instances-per-type on average and several types have 3-6 -- a 28-class detector would overfit and report a meaningless mAP. Grouped into 5 visually- and structurally-coherent families instead, each with 20+ unique defect instances.

CRACK.rationale: All thin, linear surface features regardless of substrate (concrete or steel weld) -- the visual signature a detector has to learn (a line breaking an otherwise-continuous surface) is the same class of pattern, so WELD_CRACK is grouped here by appearance rather than with the other steel/fastener defects.

SPALL_DELAM.rationale: Broad-area material loss/separation. REBAR_EXPOSED is included here rather than as its own class: it is what a spall looks like once it has progressed far enough to expose reinforcement, the same visual family (an irregular missing-material patch), just a later stage. SECTION_LOSS (steel) is the same broad-area-loss appearance in a different substrate.

CORROSION_COATING.rationale: Surface discoloration/staining defects -- rust bleed, failed coating, mineral efflorescence -- all present as an irregular color/texture change on an otherwise uniform surface, distinct from a hard-edged crack or a missing-material spall.

FASTENER.rationale: Discrete hardware-connection defects, matching the master prompt's own example grouping. BOLT_CORRODED stays here rather than in CORROSION_COATING despite its rust appearance, because the thing a detector needs to localize is the BOLT (a small, distinct, countable object), not a diffuse stained area -- the object type drives the grouping more than the surface finish does.

OTHER.rationale: Matches the master prompt's own example (bearing, joint, conduit, leakage) -- a genuine catch-all for defect types too dissimilar to each other and too rare individually (4-12 instances each) to justify their own family.
